name: java-guide  
Java language guardrails, patterns, and best practices for AI-assisted development. Use when working with Java files (.java), pom.xml, build.gradle, or when the user mentions Java. Provides modern Java patterns (records, sealed classes, streams), testing standards, and Spring conventions.

> Applies to: Java 17+, Spring Boot, Maven/Gradle, Enterprise Applications  
1. **Immutability by Default**: Prefer records, `final` fields, and unmodifiable collections
